transcript.text: Thanks, everyone. We need to lock the CloudScale Summit booth plan this week so design, travel, and staffing can move. Please send me your planning input today: Sales—expected meeting volume and lead goals by product line; Product—launch/demo priorities and who must be onsite; Events—booth logistics, badge constraints, and any upgrade options. I’ll make the final call on which product line gets the 20x20 booth and badge allocation once I have your inputs.

transcript.text: Sales input: Beacon should be strongly considered for the booth. We have three qualified Beacon deals expected to close within 45 days, and each of those accounts has already booked summit meetings specifically to see Beacon rather than Atlas. From a sales planning standpoint, that means meaningful near-term meeting volume and pipeline impact tied directly to Beacon onsite.

transcript.text: Product input: Beacon has a hard onsite requirement if we want to protect its launch timing. Beacon’s launch slips unless the summit booth includes a live demo station and at least 4 Beacon specialists on site. So if Beacon gets the 20x20 booth, we should plan around that staffing and demo footprint requirement when considering badge allocation and logistics.
